Donnelly, Seán (John) (Beechfield Road, Walkinstown, Dublin 12  and ex Irish Navy and Port and Docks and Irish Shipping and formerly of 76 Coastguard Station, Pidgeon House Road, Ringsend) April 11th 2015 (peacefully) at Peamount Hospital:  beloved husband of Julia and loving dad of Stephen, Josie, Johnny and the late Anthony:  he will be sadly missed by his loving family, brothers Paddy and Jimmy, sister Kathleen, sister-in-laws, daughters-in-law, also Kay, son-in-law, grandchildren, great granddaughter, nieces, nephews, neighbours, relatives and friends. 

May he rest in peace.

 

Reposing at his home on Monday. Removal to Newlands Cross Crematorium on Tuesday afternoon arriving for 2pm Funeral Mass with Cremation immediately afterwards.  Family flowers only please.  Donations if desired to The Alzheimer’s Society.
